channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Aftershocks Rock Panama Following Largest Quake in Decades
item.description: Panama was struck by its strongest earthquake in more than seven decades on Friday, prompting the evacuation of the capital’s international airport and sending people fleeing buildings as powerful aftershocks rattled the country.

item.title: Beloved frozen pizza brand discontinued after nearly six decades on US supermarket shelves
item.description: Conagra Brands has discontinued Celeste frozen pizzas, ending a nearly six-decade run for the budget-friendly favourite. The decision is part of a wider strategy to simplify its product portfolio, cut less profitable brands and redirect resources towards stronger growth opportunities.

item.title: Trump launches fresh bid to remove Fed Governor Lisa Cook — White House hearing scheduled for November 5
item.description: The November 5 hearing is likely to become a focal point in the continuing legal and political dispute, with implications extending beyond Cook’s position to the broader question of Federal Reserve independence.

item.title: When BJP protested against the Election Commission in 2014; here's where and why it happened
item.description: Ahead of Cockroach Janta Party's October 10 protest in Delhi, &nbsp;revisit the time when Bharatiya Janta Party staged protests against the the Election Commission in Varanasi and Delhi.&nbsp;

item.title: New GRAP Rules in Delhi; Restrictions in NCR October 2026: Are you aware of this parking fees update?
item.description: Delhi will double parking fees at authorised sites from 1 November to 28 February to discourage private vehicle use during winter pollution. The plan also includes vehicle restrictions, PUCC checks, work-from-home measures and tighter GRAP curbs across NCR.

item.title: Delhi Metro closes entry, exit till tomorrow 6 pm: Here's the list of revised stations to remain shut amid CJP protests
item.description: The Supreme Court earlier today directed authorities to ensure that metro train services are not completely suspended in Delhi ahead of the October 10 protests led by CJP. Initially 57 metro stations were announced to be closed.

item.title: Delhi Police steps up security ahead of CJP protest. Ola, Uber cabs to face restrictions?
item.description: Delhi Police has stepped up security ahead of the protest, which is being held to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over allegations linked to the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

item.title: Elon Musk's latest tweet: 'Dear PM Ambani, Please accept my humble apologies' - Read full text
item.description: ‘Starlink has proven to be essential for saving lives during natural disasters throughout the world, when all other communications systems have failed,’ Musk said in an X post.

item.title: ‘Almost putting on lockdown’: Dhruv Rathee arrives in Delhi, questions security clampdown ahead of CJP protest
item.description: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee accused central government of putting Delhi under an ‘almost lock down’ ahead of CJP's planned protest on October 10, Saturday, demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation. Police described restrictions as precautionary, citing public safety, crowd management.&nbsp;

item.title: 'Build here. Scale here. Die here' - Pan IIT Alumni India Chairman on US PERM, H1-B news from Trump Admin
item.description: The Trump administration suspended the Permanent Labor Certification (PERM) programme for eight IT companies. It also launched probes into several universities amid strained in India-US ties.

item.title: ‘Never done a thing to foster peace’: Trump reposts David Schoen’s attack on Navi Pillay's Nobel Prize win
item.description: Donald Trump has reposted attorney David I. Schoen’s criticism of Nobel Peace Prize winner Navi Pillay, accusing her of anti-American and anti-Israel bias. Schoen also praised Trump’s diplomatic efforts and questioned the committee’s decision.

item.title: Iran claims strike on LPG tanker taking ‘illegal route’ through Hormuz
item.description: In a statement carried by Iranian state media, the Revolutionary Guards said Iranian forces had “taken control of the administration of the strait”, reiterating Tehran's efforts to regulate shipping through the strategic waterway amid the ongoing Middle East war.

item.title: Navi Pillay’s Indian connection: How a brutal colonial labour system changed generations of lives
item.description: Nobel Peace Prize winner Navi Pillay’s grandparents travelled from India to South Africa as indentured labourers. Their story traces the exploitative system that sent more than 150,000 Indians to Natal’s sugar plantations between 1860 and 1911.

item.title: Republican vs Democrat: Argument over Trump's role in Iran war turns dangerous, one shot in Ohio dog park
item.description: Two dog owners who carried firearms in their vehicle clashed over their political ideologies as they disagreed over Trump's role in the ongoing Iran conflict. The confrontation turned serious when one of them shot the other in the back. Here's what happened.

item.title: Delhi liquor shops open or closed tomorrow? Check government order amid CJP's Jantar Mantar protest call against CEC
item.description: Delhi will close all retail liquor outlets on October 10, Saturday, as a precaution to maintain public order amid political demonstrations and a planned youth-led protest by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) over alleged voter-roll discrepancies.

item.title: CJP October 10 Delhi protest news: Traffic advisory, metro curbs, mobile internet suspended — Key updates
item.description: What commuters and residents should know: The main disruptions concern metro access, traffic movement around central Delhi, railway operations and educational schedules on October 10.

item.title: CJP October 10 Delhi protest news: Here’s the full list of metro stations closed in Delhi ahead of protest against CEC
item.description: Delhi Metro will close entry and exit gates at 57 stations from 9 PM on 9 October ahead of the CJP protest demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation. The Supreme Court has said there must be no complete ban on Metro services.

item.title: CJP October 10 Delhi protest news: Internet to be suspended in 4-km radius of Janpath-Kartvya Path starting 10 pm Friday
item.description: Mobile internet services in a 4-km area around Janpath-Kartavya Path Cross will be suspended from Friday night through Saturday night ahead of the CJP protest at Jantar Mantar.

item.title: Dhruv Rathee's visa status, citizenship to be scrutinised? Why Ex-Bengaluru Police chief Bhaskar Rao seeks verification
item.description: Former Bengaluru Police Commissioner Bhaskar Rao asked the Union Home Ministry to verify YouTuber Dhruv Rathee’s citizenship, immigration status and visa compliance after Rathee attended an anti-SIR protest in Bengaluru on October 8.&nbsp;

item.title: PERM vs H-1B visa: What Trump Admin's suspension of Microsoft, TCS and other IT firms means for green card seekers
item.description: The suspension, announced by the Trump administration on October 8, bars the affected companies from submitting new PERM applications and stops the processing of pending applications, according to US officials.

item.title: Rain to continue across parts of India until 15 October: IMD
item.description: Several parts of India are likely to experience rainfall over the coming week, including north-western, central, eastern, north-eastern and southern regions from 9-15 October.

item.title: ‘If there’s a good time, it is now’: Former shipping secretary on India’s shipbuilding push
item.description: India is stepping up efforts to build a competitive shipbuilding industry with a ₹70,000 crore support package and demand for more than 100 vessels. Former shipping secretary T K Ramachandran explains how incentives, ship recycling and green vessels could boost domestic shipbuilding.

item.title: 'No complete prohibition...': SC asks Centre to regulate Delhi Metro, other public transport ahead of Oct 10 protest
item.description: The Supreme Court directed Delhi authorities not to completely suspend metro services ahead of the 10 October protests. It said operations may be regulated for law and order but commuters must not be left without public transport, and ordered authorities to publicise any restrictions.

item.title: US green-card freeze at 8 IT firms: Sridhar Vembu urges Indian techies to return, Dharmendra Pradhan backs appeal
item.description: Zoho co-founder Sridhar Vembu urged Indian technology professionals in the US to return and help build India’s tech sector. Former education minister Dharmendra Pradhan endorsed the appeal as TCS and 7 other firms face PERM suspensions that halt new and pending green-card sponsorship applications.

item.title: Scindia says satcom security clearance rests with home ministry, denies bias
item.description: Communications minister Jyotiraditya Scindia said India does not allow monopoly in any sector and therefore even as Satcom (satellite communication) is concerned there is not a single licensee that has been chosen.

item.title: Pakistan may split 4 provinces into 12-15: Why Asim Munir wants to redraw boundaries and what it means
item.description: Pakistan Army chief Asim Munir is reportedly weighing a plan to split Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan into 12-15 provinces. The proposed Pakistan map overhaul could reshape political power, weaken regional parties and expand the military’s influence.

item.title: CJP Protest Live Updates: ‘I don’t know if I’ll be arrested...’ — CJP chief’s message before Delhi protest
item.description: CJP Protest Live Updates: Cockroach Janta Party to protest gainst Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar at Jantar Mantar on October 10. However, Delhi Police has denied permission for the protest.

item.title: '10x growth potential in 10 years': Ashoka University co-founder Ashish Dhawan on India-Japan ties, FDI | Exclusive
item.description: India-Japan economic ties have 10x growth potential over the next decade, says Ashoka University’s Ashish Dhawan. He called for greater Japanese investment, stronger manufacturing and semiconductor partnerships, and improved labour mobility, citing Japan’s efforts to diversify supply chains.

item.title: Who is Navi Pillay? India-origin lawyer wins Nobel Peace Prize 2026 — Know all about her career and key achievements
item.description: Nobel Peace Prize 2026: Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay won this year's Nobel Peace Prize. A judge on the International Court of Justice, Pillay is a human rights champion who headed the Rwanda genocide tribunal and last year accused Israel of genocide in Gaza, the prize committee said.

item.title: Nobel Peace Prize 2026: Navi Pillay honoured as Nobel Committee calls for ‘a peaceful world’
item.description: Former UN human rights chief and International Court of Justice judge Navanethem Navi Pillay has received the Nobel Peace Prize for advancing peace and international law.&nbsp;

item.title: CJP protest on October 10: Delhi Police security plan, traffic curbs and what commuters should know
item.description: Delhi Police has drawn up a security plan ahead of the proposed Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) protest on October 10, including 37 blocking points in the New Delhi district and dedicated detention centres across all 15 districts. Here's what protesters, commuters and residents should know.

item.title: India-Japan trade ‘minuscule’: Expert flags opportunities in rare earths, technology | Exclusive
item.description: India-Japan trade remains limited despite strategic ties, says Ashoka University’s Prachi Mishra, highlighting opportunities in semiconductors, rare earths, investment and skilled labour to strengthen supply chains.

item.title: Nirmala Sitharaman to meet Singapore leaders, global investors on three-day visit
item.description: Union finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman will visit Singapore from 9 to 11 October.

item.title: Noida's Jewar airport to be named after PM Narendra Modi – Here's what it will be called
item.description: Uttar Pradesh’s Cabinet has approved naming the upcoming Jewar airport Narendra Modi International Airport, Noida-Jewar. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath said the airport would become the state’s largest and a major aviation hub, and thanked the prime minister for his leadership.

item.title: Centre moves to bar retailers, wholesalers from advertising prescription drugs
item.description: The Centre has invited public feedback on the proposed rules within 30 days for final notification.
